defects.title: An early-ready player was forfeited at live start (opponent_absent 0.44 s after starts_at)
defects.repro: Both players ready; one readied >10 s before the countdown ended; live starts and the first tick closes the match as opponent_absent/win.
defects.fix: arena_match_tick lifts both active players' presence to the live start (greatest(last_seen_at, starts_at)) at the countdown -> live promotion; mid-round and end-of-round absence rules unchanged.

defects.title: A forfeit receipt rendered as a zero-margin score ("@x beat me by 0")
defects.repro: Server closes a match with reason opponent_absent and equal scores; the result headline claimed a 0-margin loss.
defects.fix: The result body recognises opponent_absent/abandoned_preparing/service_outage and uses forfeit copy instead of a score margin; widget regression added.
